info.title: API-DocTest-Create Telecom Sim Replacement-v5-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM Replacement API facilitates the process of replacing existing SIM cards for telecommunications services. This endpoint allows service providers to efficiently manage SIM replacements for their customers, ensuring minimal disruption to service. Typical consumers of this API include telecom operators and customer service platforms looking to handle SIM replacement requests seamlessly. The operation supports functions like submitting replacement requests and tracking their statuses, enhancing overall customer experience and operational efficacy.

post.summary: Request a replacement for a SIM card.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to request a replacement SIM card due to loss, damage, or other reasons. Ensure to provide the necessary information to process the request efficiently.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a SIM replacement request. It contains the necessary data for processing a replacement operation, including details about the SIM card and the user account.
